visualCharacteristics: Full-width image banner slides with optional overlaid title/subtitle at varying positions and dot pager
contentPattern: Rotating slideshow of 4 linked banner images — Interactive rotating component with pager dots; each slide is an image with optional title/subtitle and link. Images carry the visual, so the section is not colored.
usage: Rotating full-width promotional banners at the top of the home page
authoring: One row per slide: banner image in cell 1, optional heading/subtitle/link in cell 2
reuseGuidance: Use for any rotating image banner/slideshow; prefer hero for a single static banner.

cells: text (content_text): optional title as heading, subtitle paragraph, link to slide target
